entities.name: Wallader
entities.description: Diminutive turtlefolk mailman on the Strixhaven campus who prefers traditional delivery.

entities.name: Nimiroti Wola
entities.description: Zimone's grandmother who sent the package.

events.summary: Wallader delivers a sender-less package to Zimone Wola at the Firejolt Café, apologizing for the delay.
events.quote: Wallader delivered a package to Zimone Wola at the Firejolt Café.

events.summary: Zimone recognizes the package as from her grandmother Nimiroti Wola.
events.quote: Zimone knew it was from her grandmother Nimiroti Wola just from its looks.
